evidence: The handle features a vertical red comfort pad and lacks an index finger trigger, characteristic of the Gen5detect.
The front collar exposes the integrated dusting and crevice tool characteristic of the Gen5detect when the wand is detached.
The body features a fluted cyan HEPA filter cap and purple cyclones on a heavy 5.00 lb handheld chassis.
contradictions: The triggerless handle with a comfort pad and integrated collar tool contradicts the trigger operation of the V15 Detect and the slim top-button layout of the V12 Detect Slim.

candidate_checks.evidence: The in-line horizontal dustbin contradicts the perpendicular bin layout of the V8 Absolute.
The handle comfort pad without a trigger and the built-in crevice tool contradict the trigger-operated V15 Detect.
The full-size body with a handle comfort pad contradicts the slim push-button motor housing of the V12 Detect Slim.
The cordless handheld stick body contradicts the spherical wheeled canister and hose design of the Big Ball.
The standard cyclone body and Gen5 handle contradict the CleanCompaktor compression mechanism of the V16 Piston Animal.
The dry handheld vacuum body contradicts the wet-cleaning dual-tank system of the WashG1.
